scope: offline one-use exact zero-session checkpoint recovery; no live ledger opened

checks.name: known prefix carries every budget; only original pending operator link can exchange
bad hash is rejected before append or lock
unknown, exchange, intake, tenant, closed, halted and wrong counters cannot recover
incomplete prefix rejects reserved final request, missing newline and excess rows
live or indeterminate old controller rejects before reopening
wrong phase/PID and expired or backwards-clock checkpoint reject
exclusive durable lock rejects second recovery even if original prefix is restored
concurrent recovery grants exactly one guard
no fresh operator mail or metadata request allowed; counters do not reset
recovered guard has no inherited owner/operator bearer or customer binding
offline fixture cannot install live recovery or bypass fixed manifest/path
